# Iterative Coding

## Homework Assignment

You have a set of 4 .csv files in `data/homework`. Each file is a timeseries of temperature and light data collected in tide pools in Oregon by Jenn Fields.

- Bring in all 4 files
- calculate the mean and standard deviation of both temperature (**Temp.C**) and light (**Intensity.lux**) for each tide pool.
- Use *both* a `for loop` and `map()` functions in your script (basically, do it twice).

**Due Tuesday 11/24/26 at 1pm**.

## Load libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(stats)
```

## for loop
### Bring in files 
```{r}
# Point to the folder on the computer
hwPath <- here("Week_13", "Data", "HW_data")

# List all files in that path matching a pattern (here, anything with .csv)
# You can use regex to be more specific about filenames # can use any regex to only find files with certain words/letters/numbers
files <- dir(path = hwPath, pattern = ".csv")

files
```

### Mean and Standard Deviations
#### Pre-allocate space for the loop
```{r}
# One row for each file and 3 columns
hw_data <- tibble(filename = rep(NA, length(files)),
                    mean_temp = rep(NA, length(files)),
                    mean_ligth = rep(NA, length(files)),
                    sd_temp = rep(NA, length(files)),
                    sd_light = rep(NA, length(files)))

hw_data
```
#### Write the basic code first
```{r}
# Test by reading in the first file (this is baseR)
raw_data <- read_csv(paste0(hwPath, "/", files[1])) #paste 0 leaves NO space 
head(raw_data)
```
#### Turn it into a for loop
```{r}
for (i in seq_along(files)) {

  raw_data <- read_csv(paste0(hwPath, "/", files[i]))

  hw_data$filename[i] <- files[i] # add filenames for each row
  hw_data$mean_temp[i] <- mean(raw_data$Temp.C, na.rm = TRUE) # add temp means
  hw_data$mean_ligth[i] <- mean(raw_data$Intensity.lux, na.rm = TRUE) # add light means
  hw_data$sd_temp[i] <- sd(raw_data$Temp.C, na.rm = TRUE) # add standard deviation of temp
  hw_data$sd_light[i] <- sd(raw_data$Intensity.lux, na.rm = TRUE) # add standard deviation of light

}

hw_data
```

## purrr map ()
Do the exact same thing using `map()` functions

### Find the files
```{r}
mapFiles <- dir(path = hwPath, pattern = ".csv", full.names = TRUE) # saves the entire path

mapFiles
```

### Mean and Standard Deviations 
```{r}
mapData <- mapFiles |>
  set_names() |> # names each list element with its file name
  map(read_csv) |> # a list of 4 dataframes
  list_rbind(names_to = "filename") |> # stack them; list names go in a "filename" column - first column name
  group_by(filename) |> # calculate means and sd
  summarise(mean_temp = mean(Temp.C, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_light = mean(Intensity.lux, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_temp = sd(Temp.C, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_light = sd(Intensity.lux, na.rm = TRUE))

mapData
```
